note: Rust foundation and supplier behavior has executable coverage. Partial foundation coverage does not claim completed offer/reservation/trust flows. Financial/advanced scope remains deferred by ADR-002; private Python evidence is historical only.

items.limitations: Mapped tests cover the generated Rust foundation/supplier behavior; all other active uses of this rule remain pending in their assigned domain tasks.
Covers active published offer discovery by coordinates, radius, category, price, and bounded pagination; reservation creation is tested in subsequent tasks.
P03-01 proves immediate confirmation of whole units on bookable published offers with conserved buckets, caps, audit and replay; cancellation/pickup lifecycles remain in later P03 tasks.
P03-02 proves atomic available-to-committed confirms within account caps: final-unit races yield one success, parallel offers cannot bypass caps, failures roll back with no audit.
Mapped tests cover database whole-unit inventory conservation check; subsequent reservation commitments and handover dispositions remain in their assigned domain tasks.
P03-01 proves commitments never exceed availability with atomic available-to-committed moves under the conserved_inventory constraint.
Mapped tests add P03-02 proof that final-unit races and parallel cap races accept exactly one commitment on real PostgreSQL.
Mapped tests add P04-01 proof that pickup secrets are hashed single-use scoped evidence with holder-only issuance; handover redemption lands in P04-02.
Mapped tests add P03-05 proof that expiry moves exactly the accepted quantity, never more; the handover flow that completes INV-008 remains in a later phase.
Mapped tests add P02-05 owner-authorized correction/withdrawal reason, actor, prior/resulting audit coverage; reservation and handover adjustments remain in their assigned tasks.

Mapped tests prove edits move only admitted+available together, withdrawals move only available to disposed, committed/fulfilled never rewritten, and races keep conserved buckets; reservation release rules remain in P03/P04.
Mapped tests cover accountable supplier, establishment, point foreign keys and category/unit definition; public offer publication and discovery remain in their assigned domain tasks.
Mapped tests cover draft surplus classification validation and persistence; publication checks remain pending in subsequent tasks.
Mapped tests cover zero-price safety and condition parity on draft offers; publication pricing remains pending in subsequent tasks.
Mapped tests add P03-02 proof that suspended consumers hold no reservation authority.
Mapped tests add P03-02 proof that supplier owners cannot confirm their own offers.
Mapped tests add P03-03 proof that HTTP-displayed accepted price, condition, times and policy stay stable after offer quantity correction and pickup-point relocation.
Mapped test proves published offers store fixed BRL or zero price directly at pickup without granting consumer lock or priority; reservations and commit locking are tested in subsequent tasks.
P03-01 proves stored price, condition, point version, intervals and policy snapshots survive later edits and cannot be rewritten or deleted.
P03-01 proves free and at-pickup reservations confirm immediately with no online payment state.
